Warm bulletin for new travelers
It is easier with this note
Pet travel guidance for travelers

Travelers using Aurelia Skyways should check with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before booking space for any companion animal. The desk gives clear guidance on carrier fit, cabin or hold placement, and the papers needed for a smooth journey. Bring your animal's health records, feeding notes, and any care items that support calm handling.

Keep the carrier secure, labeled, and clean. Make sure the animal can stand, turn, and rest without strain. Feed lightly before travel and avoid last-minute changes that could upset the animal. If you arrive with a nervous pet, speak up at once so staff can help with screening and boarding in a steady way.

Teddy was handled with care in earlier service checks, and that same attention applies to every traveler with a pet. Gabriel Tanaka and Emil Ibrahim also received routine guidance from the desk when they prepared their trips. Calm planning reduces delays and keeps the cabin safer for all passengers.

For plain, practical help with companion animal travel, go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
